events.evidence: Russia's Gazprom announces the complete shutdown of the Nord Stream 1 natural gas pipeline for three days for unscheduled maintenance
European Union foreign ministers agree to suspend a visa facilitation agreement with Russia, making it more difficult and more expensive for Russian tourists to enter the EU
The Suez Canal was temporarily blocked after a ship ran aground on Wednesday evening

label.note: Nord Stream shutdown and EU-Russia visa suspension reinforce energy and geopolitical risk; Suez blockage adds trade friction.
